name: pill-top-nav
title: PillTopNav
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Centered pill nav with a sliding indicator, search, bell and avatar.

meta.descriptionEs: Menú centrado en píldora con indicador que se desliza, búsqueda, avisos y avatar.
meta.usage: <PillTopNav items={secciones} active="dashboard" onNavigate={ir} user={{ name: "Ana Ruiz" }} />

docs: Clean-room rebuild of a dashboard style seen in a public Code XR video (Dashboard V15); its source is not published, so no code, copy, colors or assets were copied. The accent is the host primary token. All sample data is fictional. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
